spans.s:
mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं)
1 Formidable, fearful, terrific.
2 Sharp, acute.
3 Relating or belonging to RUDRA or Ś

Violent, wrathful, irascible.
mn. (-द्रः-द्रं)
Wrath, rage, (the sentiment as an object of poetical description)
m. (-द्रः)
1 Heat, warmth.
2 The cold season.
3 YAMA.
f. (-द्री)
GAURI, the wife of ŚIVA.
E.
रुद्र ŚIVA, &c., and अण् aff.

f. (-ता)
Fierceness, formidableness.
E.
रौद्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रौद्रत्वं.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Formidable, terrific.
E.
रौद्र, and दर्शन appearance.
